why_best: A focused visual heartbeat grounds the interface in real-time execution, giving the audience immediate confidence that input is being processed.
why_bad: Introducing bouncy, playful micro-interactions would undermine the sterile, technical tone expected from a professional workspace environment.
trap: A poor execution might allow the focal indicator to continue pulsing indefinitely after content generation begins, cluttering the view instead of yielding gracefully to the emerging data.
